messages:
maria_devrel: Quick sync — planning a dev-focused content push (week of May 12). Deliverables: 2 x 15min tutorial vids, 1 tiny ref-app repo, reproducible benchmark blog, webinar, and routing for inbound leads.
ben_marketing: 👍 Need dates for promo calendar and a sharp CTA for both community and enterprise.
ashley_growth: Promo cadence idea: emails at -10, -3, day-of, +1; community posts at -7 and day-of. Ads start -7.
tom_engineer: I can own the ref app + bench script. Will include `run_bench.sh` and Dockerfile. ETA Wed May 1.
katie_content: Benchmark post: one clear comparison chart (latency vs cost), commands to reproduce, <1000 words. I'll draft.
maria_devrel: Routing: form fields company_size, use_case, compliance. Rule: company_size>250 OR compliance includes "on-prem"/"SOC2" -> #sales-inbound else -> #community-onboarding. Preserve utm params.
leads-bot: Affirmative. Recommend also tagging domains in an enterprise list and adding a repeat-visitor score. I can expose these as hidden form fields.
ben_marketing: I'll build the landing page + form with hidden utm_source/utm_campaign. ETA Tue Apr 30.
ashley_growth: SLA: 24h AE follow-up for sales-tagged leads. Community signups get an automated welcome with tutorial links.
tom_engineer: For reproducibility include hardware note + exact command: `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-small --seq 512 --iters 200`. Will include expected numbers in README.
katie_content: I'll share draft + chart PNGs by Fri May 3 for legal/product review.
maria_devrel: Nice. Everyone drop a single deliverable + ETA and I'll add to the board. I'll open a PR for routing rules later today. :rocket:
